narrative:
The consolidated FY2027 plan brings every business unit into one view: GBP 3.80B revenue, 9.6% underlying operating margin and GBP 245M capex. It passes the finance gate, with revenue 1.3% below the group ambition and margin above the 9.0% floor.

The bridge from the FY2026 forecast is driven by PMI premium rates (+GBP 118M), dental and clinic expansion (+GBP 64M) and membership growth (+GBP 46M), partly offset by FX on Bupa Global (-GBP 16M) and a flat NHS dental contract (-GBP 6M).

For the UK CFO, the cycle took six weeks instead of twelve on Oracle EPM, and every number traces back to its source and its owner. Because it is the same Snowflake platform that group planning already uses, the risk team's concern about lock-in to a separate planning vendor does not apply.

signals.title: Oracle EPM BU Planning Paused
signals.excerpt: Business-unit planning on Oracle EPM has been paused. Group planning already runs on Snowflake after the TM1 to Anaplan to Snowflake migration delivered with EY.

signals.title: Reporting Migration to Snowflake + Sigma
signals.excerpt: Business Objects reporting is moving to Snowflake with Sigma, giving finance input grids, workflow and write-back on governed data.

signals.title: PeopleSoft GL Approaching End of Support
signals.excerpt: Any GL replacement must feed the planning model directly, avoiding a new reconciliation layer between ledger and plan.
